Rachel CS: Heads-up — StratoVista's recommendations team pushed a workflow change this morning; embedding writes jumped ~7x and their endpoint tails spiked. Customer is excited about accuracy gains but worried about latency. :grimacing:
Omar CSE: I see traces starting 08:47 UTC, they increased context window and batch size for rerank. Likely KV cache thrashing + backend write contention.
Rachel CS: Onboarding note: they completed basic onboarding but skipped the perf deep-dive. Nina, they mentioned considering Dedicated last quarter — should we surface that?
Nina AM: Renewal is 2026-11-10. This is a clear expansion lead — they're adding 2 more product teams next quarter. But yes, risk if we don't stabilize. I'll prep a high-level upsell brief.
Omar CSE: Immediate action: 1) enable per-customer KV namespace + longer prefix TTL 2) suggest quantized model variant for rerank 3) add small dedicated slice for soak testing
Akio SRE: I can provision a 2x test slice in ~70 minutes and run a synthetic embed writer to reproduce tail spikes. Need approval to allocate.
autoscale-bot: alert: stratovista-prod embeddings queue length > 300 for 9m. Oncall notified. <https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/REDACTED>
Rachel CS: Customer feedback to capture: "great relevancy but occasional 300-700ms spikes during peak rerank; sometimes results return incomplete when backpressure occurs." Filed as ENG-5409.
Nina AM: Please include in the upsell brief: expected latency reduction, cost delta, migration timeline, rollback criteria, and a small pilot offer (2-week free test).
Omar CSE: sample config I'll use in the demo:
```
POST /v1/customers/stratovista/config
{ "kv_namespace": "stratovista-v2", "prefix_ttl": 7200, "use_quantized": true, "batch_embeddings": true, "batch_size": 64 }
```
Akio SRE: Test slice provisioned: 10.200.4.12. Running synthetic load @1.8k embed/s. Initial tail latency improved ~18% under the slice. Collecting 30m of metrics.
Rachel CS: Action items:
- Omar: perf runbook + firmed cost estimate for 2x and 4x slices (due EOD)
- Akio: collect logs & metrics from test slice (in progress)
- Nina: draft upsell brief + pilot offer + renewal notes
I'll message StratoVista with a short summary and propose the 2-week pilot. :thumbsup:
Omar CSE: on it, will include GPU/profile options and tradeoffs.
Akio SRE: will share logs in #eng-runtime when ready.
Rachel CS: Thanks team — marking this as a high-priority expansion signal in CRM and scheduling a follow-up midweek.
